Inside the Factory Turning Millions of Fresh Peanut Pods into Pure Peanut Oil | Full Process
Discover the complete industrial process of transforming millions of freshly harvested peanut pods into pure, golden peanut oil. Follow every stage inside a massive modern factory—from soil removal, washing, drying, shelling and kernel sorting to roasting, pressing, filtration, quality inspection and automated bottling.

See how advanced machinery and large-scale production lines efficiently extract rich, aromatic oil while maintaining cleanliness and consistent quality throughout the entire process.
